label: Mount & Blade: Warband sandboxes
description: How Mount & Blade: Warband sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: vortex.

notes: Each mod is a folder under Modules containing a module.ini. The original (22100) and With Fire & Sword (48720) share the layout but use mount&blade.exe and mb_wfas.exe.
Hard links are the default: the game folder and the staging folder are almost always on one drive, and nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod.

presets.description: Mods deployed into the game folder.

presets.label: Clean
presets.description: Nothing deployed: the vanilla game, for checking whether a bug is yours.
